title: Savoury Cheddar and Parmesan Waffles
changes_from_base: A savoury white wholemeal batter with dried herb seasoning, grated Cheddar and Parmesan folded in before the whisked whites; no sugar, vanilla or salt.
summary: Savoury waffles packed with Cheddar and Parmesan, light enough from whisked egg whites to work as a side or a base for toppings.

ingredients.item: dried Italian herb seasoning (or your favourite seasoning blend)

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk 170 g white wholemeal flour, 2 tsp baking powder and 2 tsp Italian herb seasoning together in a large bowl.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Whisk 2 egg yolks, 340 ml milk and 57 g melted butter together in a jug, and whisk the 2 egg whites to stiff peaks in another bowl.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Stir the yolk mixture into the dry ingredients just until combined, then fold in 57 g Cheddar and 57 g Parmesan followed by the whisked egg whites.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Scoop the batter into the hot iron and cook as its instructions say.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve at once, or keep warm in a 93 °C oven.

tips: Fold the cheeses in before the whisked egg whites so you don't knock all the air out of the batter.
Whisk the whites to stiff peaks in a clean, dry bowl so they hold their structure once folded in.
These savoury waffles pair well with anything you'd serve alongside melted cheese.
storage: Leftover waffles can be frozen for up to 1 month. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
